revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Though the name Τσενβῆς is only attested in Lefebvre, IGChrEg 253.2, its first element is one of several possible renderings of demotic Tȝ-šr.t-n-. The name might therefore be a new spelling for Tȝ-šr.t-n-bs, for which see http://www.trismegistos.org/nam/detail.php?record=13638 . As noted by Sosin, the scribe seems to have insisted on the sigma (which has the same form as in Ψεναμοῦνις, line 3), perhaps to avoid any confusion with a large π (even though he does not appear to use such a form of π).

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Τσ is clear from the digital image: http://www.psi-online.it/documents/psi;3;162; syntax => PN D. Hagedorn (digital image). Scribe appears to have gone over sigma twice (does not appear to have been corrected from another letter). For the name see e.g. IGChrEg 253.2. Typo, good.

Z. 4: Πενβῆτος → Τσενβῆτος (am Photo). Der Name, der sich zu den häufigen Feminina stellt, die mit Τσεν- beginnen, ist epigraphisch bezeugt, s. Preisigke, Namenbuch. Z. 7: Μάρχου → Μάρκου (Eingabefehler der DDbDP).
